content.description:
PaidXPO is a deflationary meme coin built on the Cardano block chain made for creators by creators. Ever heard about photographers and videographers getting offered being paid in “exposure” instead of actual cash? Yeah, we have too and we lived it! — and that’s why we’re flipping the script! Introducing PaidXPO, the meme-inspired crypto with a twist.

With our funky fresh token and mascot, XPO, we’re giving creatives the power to turn their “Exposure” into currency. Say goodbye to empty promises and hello to a world where memes can potentially pay the bills! Ready to join the fun? Buckle up and let’s make “getting paid in exposure” realistic.
